subject: Overlap adjudication: Orbit Analytics — partner integration vs direct account stewardship
thread_summary: BrightBridge flagged that Orbit Analytics is appearing in their partner pipeline and Redwood's direct AE is also engaging. Team proposes a stewardship rubric and quick MOU to avoid territory conflict; Karthik to own partner coordination and draft MOU.
messages:
From: Emily Park <emily@brightbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Orbit Analytics — apparent pipeline overlap with BrightBridge integration

Hi Marissa,

Quick note — our PS lead surfaced Orbit Analytics as a target where BrightBridge has an active integration roadmap (we've been running a pilot with them since Aug). I just saw inbound outreach from your direct AE (Mike Turner copied below) and wanted to flag the overlap before we both escalate the opportunity.

Attached is a small extract showing the opportunity lineage and the integration demo notes (file: overlap-evidence.csv).

Where we usually see friction is when both parties assume 'account stewardship' for joint integrations. BrightBridge's proposal is to operate as the primary integration partner (we can handle first- and second-line integration support) with Redwood owning the billing relationship if the customer prefers a direct contract. That model has worked with other ISVs (we call it a "custodial co-sell" arrangement).

Can we get a brief sync today to decide whether this should be routed to partner-led motion or stay as direct sales? If you prefer, Karthik or Olga can own the triage call.

Best,
Emily
--
Emily Park | Head of Alliances, BrightBridge Solutions
emily@brightbridge.com | +1 415-555-1212

[attachment: overlap-evidence.csv (CSV, 19KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit Analytics — apparent pipeline overlap with BrightBridge integration

Thanks for flagging, Emily — really appreciate the heads-up and the CSV.

Quick thoughts:
- We should avoid a full-arbitration immediately; a lightweight stewardship rubric will help us decide quickly and repeatably.
- Proposal: if BrightBridge is the integration owner and provides productized connector support + onboarding, we default to partner-led motion with Redwood handling billing and platform SLOs. If integration work is ad-hoc or professional-services heavy, Redwood retains AE stewardship.

I've sketched a one-page map to capture the decision points (map-sketch.png). I'm free 30–45m this afternoon. If Karthik can take point to draft an MOU, that would speed things.

Marissa
--
Marissa Cole | Director, Alliances (Americas) — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0100

[attachment: map-sketch.png (PNG, 120KB)]

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Emily Park <emily@brightbridge.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T11:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit Analytics — apparent pipeline overlap with BrightBridge integration

On Sat, Oct 2, 2027 at 9:12 AM Emily Park <emily@brightbridge.com> wrote:
> Quick note — our PS lead surfaced Orbit Analytics as a target where BrightBridge has an active integration roadmap (we've been running a pilot with them since Aug).

Couple of product constraints to surface for the triage:
- If BrightBridge plans to ship a certified plugin (containerized connector or managed integration) that calls Redwood APIs on behalf of Orbit, we should prioritize partner-led onboarding and provide a supported "integration partner" model (we can gate feature access via partner API keys and usage routing).
- If the work requires model architecture changes or custom kernel tuning for Orbit (heavy engineering lift), that will likely sit with Redwood and we should keep AE ownership.

Operations note: we can implement a short-term routing rule (30d) to defer inbound calls to BrightBridge for integration demos while we finalize an MOU. Please add the HubSpot record when you send the draft: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

-Jonas
--
Jonas Weber | Sr. Product Partnerships — Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.com

From: Emily Park <emily@brightbridge.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Mike Turner <mike@orbitanalytics.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T13:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit Analytics — apparent pipeline overlap with BrightBridge integration

Thanks Jonas — that aligns with our expectations. Fast reply with our proposed path:

1) BrightBridge will be the integration owner and deliver a productized connector (we estimate 8–12 weeks).
2) Redwood will be the billing owner and provide platform SLOs.
3) We'll sign a short MOU that outlines support boundaries, revenue routing for professional services (if any), and a 90-day exclusivity window for integration demos.

I've attached a draft mutual action plan for you to review (mutual_action_plan_v1.docx). I'll also route a DocuSign link for quick acceptance if the redlines are minor: https://www.docusign.net/a/3G7bJ-mutual_action_plan_v1

If that sounds ok, Emily suggested a 11:30AM slot to sync today — otherwise I'm flexible.

Emily
--
Emily Park | Head of Alliances, BrightBridge Solutions
[attachment: mutual_action_plan_v1.docx (DOCX, 45KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily@brightbridge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-10-02T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Orbit Analytics — apparent pipeline overlap with BrightBridge integration

Appreciate the clear proposal, Emily. 11:30 worked — thanks for the quick turn. Notes from the call:
- Agreed path = BrightBridge integration owner + Redwood billing owner.
- Karthik will be the partner owner for Orbit (coord MOU, HubSpot update, primary contact for PS scoping).
- Olga will validate any technical SLOs and sign off on the connector acceptance criteria.
- Jonas will iterate the routing rule (30d) after Karthik uploads the HubSpot record.

Next steps (owners):
- Karthik: draft MOU for internal review and share with BrightBridge (target EOD Tue).
- Olga: produce acceptance criteria checklist and compatibility notes (target Thu).
- Emily: circulate final DocuSign link once Karthik posts redlines.

I'll mark this as partner-led and update the account owner in SF/HubSpot after we have the signed MOU. Thanks everyone for the fast coordination.

Marissa
